summary: Rogerson Kenny is a Mulgrave (Melbourne) business accounting firm offering tax, SMSF, cloud bookkeeping and virtual CFO services. Rob Deayton is a Director and has been with the firm since 2005. The firm celebrates its 50th anniversary in 2026, has grown to more than 35 professionals and has moved into a new Mulgrave office.

hooks.text: 50th anniversary and move to a new Mulgrave office with 35+ staff: growth and capacity moment.
Virtual CFO service oversees payroll, bookkeeping, debtors and AP: multiple ledgers to reconcile per client.
Xero platinum member plus cloud-first positioning.

risks.text: LinkedIn shows employee decline (6-7% YoY) in third-party data, conflicting with the firm's stated growth; no public sign of AI tooling either way.

gaps: No recent posts by Rob; no hiring ads found; Xero partner tier is from a 2021 article only.
